# NeoFidu

> NeoFidu is a Swiss online fiduciary (fiduciaire en ligne) serving French-speaking Switzerland. We prepare tax returns, set up companies and keep accounts for individuals, self-employed people and businesses in 6 cantons: Vaud (VD), Geneva (GE), Valais (VS), Fribourg (FR), Neuchatel (NE) and Jura (JU). We also publish free step-by-step guides for the cantonal tax software (VaudTax, GeTax, VSTax) and free tax and finance simulators.

Key information:

- NeoFidu operates in French-speaking Switzerland (Suisse romande) and also serves expats living there and Swiss citizens abroad with Swiss tax obligations
- Tax returns from CHF 89 (Basic, simple cases) and from CHF 149 (Comfort: dependents, one owned property, professional expenses)
- Company creation from CHF 290 (sole proprietorship), CHF 990 (Sarl / LLC), CHF 1'490 (SA / AG)
- All services are delivered online
- The site is in French with English versions of most pages under https://neofidu.ch/en (services, tax guides, simulators, municipality pages)

## Tax return guides (step by step)

Each guide follows the cantonal tax software screen by screen, with official 2026 deduction amounts and return codes. English versions quote the French software labels.

- [VaudTax guide (FR)](https://neofidu.ch/guide/vaudtax): How to fill in the Vaud tax return in VaudTax
- [VaudTax guide (EN)](https://neofidu.ch/en/guide/vaudtax): English version for expats

Same paths under /en/guide/vaudtax/

- GeTax chapters: [before you start](https://neofidu.ch/guide/getax/avant-de-commencer), [personal situation and children](https://neofidu.ch/guide/getax/situation-personnelle), [salary](https://neofidu.ch/guide/getax/salaire), [work expenses](https://neofidu.ch/guide/getax/frais-professionnels), [pension savings: pillar 3a, catch-up, buy-ins](https://neofidu.ch/guide/getax/prevoyance), [accounts, securities and crypto](https://neofidu.ch/guide/getax/comptes-titres), [wealth and debts](https://neofidu.ch/guide/getax/fortune-dettes), [property](https://neofidu.ch/guide/getax/immeubles), [deductions](https://neofidu.ch/guide/getax/deductions), [source tax, TOU, quasi-residents and cross-border workers](https://neofidu.ch/guide/getax/impot-source-tou), [checking and filing](https://neofidu.ch/guide/getax/verifier-envoyer). - [VSTax guide (EN)](https://neofidu.ch/en/guide/vstax): English version for expats and holiday-home owners
- VSTax chapters: [before you start](https://neofidu.ch/guide/vstax/avant-de-commencer), [personal situation and children](https://neofidu.ch/guide/vstax/situation-personnelle), [salary and pensions](https://neofidu.ch/guide/vstax/salaire), [work expenses](https://neofidu.ch/guide/vstax/frais-professionnels), [pension savings: pillar 3a, catch-up, buy-ins, lump sums](https://neofidu.ch/guide/vstax/prevoyance), [accounts, securities and crypto](https://neofidu.ch/guide/vstax/comptes-titres), [wealth and debts](https://neofidu.ch/guide/vstax/fortune-dettes), [property, holiday homes and furnished lets](https://neofidu.ch/guide/vstax/immeubles), [deductions](https://neofidu.ch/guide/vstax/deductions), [source tax, TOU and quasi-residents](https://neofidu.ch/guide/vstax/impot-source-tou), [checking and filing](https://neofidu.ch/guide/vstax/verifier-envoyer). ## Free simulators

All simulators are free, instant and need no sign-up. Each one has an English version under https://neofidu.ch/en/simulateur/

- [Tax simulator](https://neofidu.ch/simulateur/impots): Income and wealth tax by canton and municipality, with real municipal coefficients
- [Net salary simulator](https://neofidu.ch/simulateur/salaire-net): Gross-to-net salary with AVS, AI, APG, AC, LPP and taxes, all 26 cantons
- [Pillar 3a simulator](https://neofidu.ch/simulateur/3eme-pilier): Tax savings from pillar 3a contributions (2026 limit CHF 7'258)
- [Retirement simulator](https://neofidu.ch/simulateur/retraite): Retirement income from AVS, LPP (2nd pillar) and pillar 3a
- [Imputed rental value simulator](https://neofidu.ch/simulateur/valeur-locative): Impact of the abolition of the imputed rental value (valeur locative) for homeowners
- [Property gains tax simulator](https://neofidu.ch/simulateur/gain-immobilier): Tax on the gain when selling property, by canton and holding period
- [Rent reduction simulator](https://neofidu.ch/simulateur/baisse-loyer): Whether a tenant can ask for a rent cut based on the mortgage reference rate
- [Swiss tax map](https://neofidu.ch/simulateur/carte-impots): Interactive comparison of tax burden across the 26 cantons

## Services

- [Tax returns for individuals](https://neofidu.ch/particuliers): Personal tax return preparation (VD, GE, VS, FR, NE, JU)
- [Expats](https://neofidu.ch/en/expats): Tax returns in English for foreigners living in French-speaking Switzerland, including source-taxed workers (B permit) and TOU
- [Swiss citizens abroad](https://neofidu.ch/suisses-de-letranger): Swiss tax returns, property and double taxation for Swiss people living abroad ([France](https://neofidu.ch/suisses-de-letranger/france), [Canada](https://neofidu.ch/suisses-de-letranger/canada))
- [Self-employed](https://neofidu.ch/independants) ([EN](https://neofidu.ch/en/independants)): Accounting and tax returns for sole proprietors
- [Company creation](https://neofidu.ch/creation-entreprise) ([EN](https://neofidu.ch/en/creation-entreprise)): Setting up a sole proprietorship, Sarl or SA
- [Businesses](https://neofidu.ch/entreprises) ([EN](https://neofidu.ch/en/entreprises)): Accounting, VAT and corporate tax returns
- [Associations and foundations](https://neofidu.ch/associations-fondations) ([EN](https://neofidu.ch/en/associations-fondations)): Services for non-profit organizations
- [Free second opinion](https://neofidu.ch/second-avis) ([EN](https://neofidu.ch/en/second-avis)): Send your current fiduciary invoice and get an answer within 48 hours on whether you overpay
- [Pricing](https://neofidu.ch/tarifs) ([EN](https://neofidu.ch/en/tarifs)): Full price list
- [Submit a request](https://neofidu.ch/demande): Online form to request a service or a quote
- [FAQ](https://neofidu.ch/faq) ([EN](https://neofidu.ch/en/faq))

## Data and reference pages

- [Municipalities](https://neofidu.ch/communes) ([EN](https://neofidu.ch/en/communes)): Municipalities of the 6 cantons with tax coefficients, population and local data
- [Canton pages](https://neofidu.ch/cantons): Tax information for [Vaud](https://neofidu.ch/cantons/vaud), [Geneva](https://neofidu.ch/cantons/geneve), [Valais](https://neofidu.ch/cantons/valais), [Fribourg](https://neofidu.ch/cantons/fribourg), [Neuchatel](https://neofidu.ch/cantons/neuchatel) and [Jura](https://neofidu.ch/cantons/jura)
- [Business observatory](https://neofidu.ch/observatoire): Aggregate statistics on companies in French-speaking Switzerland by canton and legal form. Individual company pages have been removed (they return HTTP 410)
- [Swiss debt clock](https://neofidu.ch/dette-suisse) ([EN](https://neofidu.ch/en/swiss-debt)): Federal debt, revenue and deficit in real time, based on the 2026 federal budget
